<!-- pr-reviewer: b8057dfea252e71c421bc737db75b6d2ab3e773e -->
Needs changes before merge.

The local checks passed. One required item is missing: the before and after UI screenshots.

### What looks good

- The UI and MCP tool use the same undoable command.
- The six sheet-job tests cover undo, posting depth, clamp clearance, WCS drift, input validation and project reload.
- The allowance and clamp tests detect removal of their safety checks.

### Local results merged with main

This is a safety-tier review. I tested the local trial merge with upstream main at `c2423f170`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge | Passed. No conflicts. |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Passed: 476 steps, 0 failed, 39.4 minutes. The logs report 4,793 passed tests and 34 ignored tests. |
| App test build | Passed in the quick gate. |
| `mcp_sheet_job` | 6 passed, 0 failed. |
| UI test build | Passed in the quick gate. |
| UI library tests, from `crates/ui` | 1,385 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored. This count is included in the quick total. |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed. |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | Passed: 199 steps, 0 failed, 31.0 minutes. All reached app targets ran. The logs report 43 passed tests. |

### Mutations run

I ran these mutations separately in the review worktree:

1. I disabled the allowance-floor check. `a_through_cut_within_the_allowance_posts_from_the_stated_zero_and_past_it_is_refused` failed as expected.
2. I restored the floor check and disabled the clamp check. `a_rapid_across_below_the_clamp_plane_is_refused_by_name` failed as expected.

I restored both checks. Then all six `mcp_sheet_job` tests passed again. The worktree has no source changes.

### Extra suites run

None required by the extra selection rules. The diff changes no fixture, golden, test-data or importer path.

### Requested before merge

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_sheet_job_row.rs:95`: Add before and after screenshots of the setup Settings page to the PR body. The new checklist changes the UI, but the body has no screenshots. Structural tests do not meet this review requirement. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them from the body.

### Notes

No goldens changed. No dependency, build script, workflow or process file changed. I used no GitHub runner. The PR remains a draft because the screenshot requirement is not met.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Added the missing before and after setup Settings screenshots to the PR body.

The images are on the fork’s `pr-screenshots` branch at `6364a66fe60717dc6792b7abdbc12b35039f0607`. The PR body links them by that immutable commit.

The screenshot-link pin was RED on the original body and after removing the screenshot section. Restoring the section made it GREEN. The before and after capture assertions passed.

Quick gate: 472 steps, 0 failed (29.9 minutes). Clippy: GREEN, exit 0 (1 minute 31 seconds), for `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`.

The PR head is unchanged: `b8057dfea252e71c421bc737db75b6d2ab3e773e`.

Please re-review the screenshot finding.

<!-- pr-reviewer: b8057dfea252e71c421bc737db75b6d2ab3e773e -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The author added the evidence requested in the earlier review. The PR head did not change. I withdraw the earlier screenshot change request.

### Evidence checked

- The PR body has before and after screenshots of the setup Settings page.
- Both links load. I inspected both images. The after image shows the sheet-job checklist and the allowance row.
- The links use commit `6364a66fe60717dc6792b7abdbc12b35039f0607` on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. That commit changes only the two PNG files.
- The PR branch contains no screenshot files.

### Local results merged with main

This is a safety-tier review. I made a clean trial merge with upstream main at `5e76e6a14b366c510858bbbf660c06ca013c34d4`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| App and UI test builds | Passed in the quick gate. |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Passed: 477 steps, 0 failed, 28.3 minutes. The logs report 4,798 passed tests and 34 ignored tests. |
| `mcp_sheet_job` | All 6 tests passed. |
| UI library tests, from `crates/ui` | 1,385 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored. Both new checklist tests passed. These counts are included in the quick gate total. |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed. |

The earlier review of this same head ran `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 199 steps passed, 0 failed, 43 tests passed. That run used main at `c2423f170`. I did not repeat the heavy gate for this evidence update. See the [earlier review](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3165#issuecomment-7064305648).

### Mutations run

I repeated these checks separately in the local review worktree:

1. I disabled the allowance-floor check. `a_through_cut_within_the_allowance_posts_from_the_stated_zero_and_past_it_is_refused` failed. The post wrote a file that the test required it to refuse.
2. I restored that check and disabled the clamp check. `a_rapid_across_below_the_clamp_plane_is_refused_by_name` failed for the same reason.

I restored both checks. All 6 `mcp_sheet_job` tests then passed again. The worktree has no source changes.

### Extra suites run

None required by the extra selection rules. The diff changes no fixture, golden, test-data or importer path. No golden lines moved.

### Requested before merge

None. The screenshot finding is resolved.

### Notes

No dependency, build script, workflow or process file changed. All new checks ran locally. I used no GitHub runner. The PR merges cleanly with main.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merged ahead of the next cut on the collaborator's (mkinney) standing override, OK'd by the maintainer: non-breaking feat, clean independent review, clean merge. Its Changelog row goes in at the cut as usual.
